lead: Coming home from space is one of the most dangerous parts. A capsule must hit the air at just the right angle.
try: Press The Moon, then change the entry angle and watch what happens.
points: Too shallow, and the capsule skips off the top of the air and back out.
Too steep, and the braking crushes the crew and the heat shield gets far too hot.
The air slows the capsule from many kilometres a second to almost nothing in a few minutes, turning that speed into heat.
